messages:
Samira (People Ops): Quick one 1: putting together a very short 'first 2 weeks + 30/60/90' checklist for new managers starting Mon. Lightweight and action-oriented. TL;DR: setup, who-to-ask, first-7-day pulse, meeting-load guidance. Drop edits.

Jordan (Hiring Manager): +1. Please include a mini stakeholder map they should send by day 5 (who owns infra, product, sales, security).

Maya (Onboarding Ops): Adding: access checklist that we can mark as done in the HR system. Also recommend adding a default calendar template for manager office hours.

Alex (Eng Manager): Ops notes: ensure they know staging vs prod RBAC rules, and include Redwood Dedicated/GPU quota request if their team will run models.

Samira (People Ops): Draft below. It's intentionally short, meant to be copy-pastable into an offer pocket guide.

Samira (People Ops): MANAGER: First 48 hours (practical)
- [ ] Confirm Google + Slack + GitHub accounts active
- [ ] Redwood Console access (viewer); request billing view only if needed
- [ ] VPN/SSO and MFA enabled
- [ ] Add buddy and schedule first shadow session
- [ ] Join team channel, eng, #oncall, and #hiring

Samira (People Ops): FIRST WEEK (goals)
- Day 1: 15m team intro + 30m skip-levels slot (opt)
- Day 2-5: meet each direct report (30m) 1 use 30/60/90 template
- By Day 5: send 1-slide stakeholder map (who to contact for infra, security, product, recruiting)
- End of week: complete 7-day pulse form (access / clarity / blockers)

Samira (People Ops): 2-WEEK RULES & meeting-load
- Keep interview load <= 2 interviews/day
- Avoid >4 hours of meetings/day for first 14 days
- Block daily 1-hour focus window and 2 x 30m office hours on calendar

Samira (People Ops): 30/60/90 (short prompts)
- 30 days: understand team roadmap, meet skip-levels, triage top 3 blockers, complete 1 hiring loop interview
- 60 days: iterate on sprint/process improvements, lead 1 postmortem or feature planning, close at least one hire offer (if applicable)
- 90 days: present Q+1 plan, define 2 measurable team KPIs, hand off onboarding updates for ICs

Jordan (Hiring Manager): For hiring: add 'candidate scorecard completed within 48h' and 'interview panel debrief within 72h'.

Maya (Onboarding Ops): Pulse form sample (3 quick Qs) to add to HR: "Were any accounts missing? Is your role clear? Any urgent blockers?" We'll auto-remind at day 7.

Alex (Eng Manager): Suggestion: include a tiny 'runbook checklist' for managers on teams that own infra: access to runbooks, escalation contacts, and oncall shadow scheduled within 10 days.

Samira (People Ops): Good. Adding 'oncall shadow within 10 days' and 'prod access via request with security approval' to the checklist.

Samira (People Ops): WHO TO ASK (Day 1 shortcut)
- Onboarding ops: Maya / Priya (account & payroll)
- Infra: Alex (staging access), DevInfra (infra-team)
- Security: Mia (SSO/KMS)
- Recruiting: Jordan (hiring process)
- DevRel / SDK: Robin

Samira (People Ops): SAMPLE CALENDAR + EMAIL (pasteable)
- Calendar title: "Intro: <Name> (Manager)"
- Invite body: "Please welcome <Name>, joining as <Role> on <Date>. I'll host a 15m intro at 10:00 to say hi and share priorities.

Email sample:
```
Hi team,
Please welcome <Name> who joins us as <Role> on <Date>. I'll run a 15-minute intro at 10:00 in the team room. Please drop by to say hi and add a welcome note in #team. 
Thanks,
<Manager>
```

Jordan (Hiring Manager): Can HR auto-send that email template with offer acceptance? saves a step.

Maya (Onboarding Ops): We can. We'll add a flag on the welcome flow to auto-generate the intro email.

OnboardBot: New-manager-onepager created: /docs/onboarding/manager-quickstart-onepager.md

Samira (People Ops): Final note: I'll convert this to a one-pager PDF and append to the offer packet. If there's no other edits, I'll push updates to the HR checklist and the onboarding system tonight. :sparkles:
